title: Account profiles show the next Pollen reset
summary:
Account profiles gained a Pollen reset timestamp, Flux Klein editing got its request format corrected, and two bits of documentation were tidied up.

The account profile response gained `nextResetAt`, an ISO 8601 timestamp for the next daily Pollen reset, or `null` when no tier grant has been recorded. The account docs were also corrected to show `/account/profile`, `/account/balance`, and `/account/usage` without the `/api` prefix.

Flux Klein image editing now sends prompt, dimensions, and optional seed in the URL query, with a JSON array of base64 images in the POST body. Width and height still default to 1024.

The Code of Conduct now directs reports of abusive or harassing behavior to core@pollinations.ai.

highlights.title: Pollen reset timestamp
highlights.text: Read `nextResetAt` from the account profile response to see when the next daily Pollen reset is due. It returns `null` if no tier grant has been recorded yet. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
